title: Application Launcher's username requires a reboot in order to change fonts
line: The username in the Application Launcher now switches to a new system font right away, without restarting.
explanation: Kirigami's Heading sets font.pointSize and font.weight on top of the style's Label, which pins the whole font, so it kept the family it had when created. On top of that, Plasma's Kirigami theme (libplasma's kirigamiplasmastyle) read the application font once and never updated Kirigami.Theme.defaultFont, so in plasmashell nothing bound to it followed a font change. Heading now also binds font.family to the theme's default font, and the Plasma theme re-reads its fonts whenever the application font changes; both are needed.

commits.message:
Heading: follow the theme's font family

Setting font.pointSize and font.weight overrides the style's binding on
the whole font, so a Heading kept the family it had when it was created
and ignored later font changes until restart. Bind the family as well.

BUG: 519494

kirigamiplasmastyle: follow application font changes

The Plasma theme for Kirigami read the application font only once, so
Kirigami.Theme.defaultFont kept the old family and size after the font
was changed until plasmashell restarted. Sync the fonts on each change.

BUG: 519494

Setting font.pointSize and font.weight overrides the style's binding on
the whole font, so a Heading kept the family it had when it was created
and ignored later font changes until restart. Bind the family as well.

BUG: 519494

 src/controls/Heading.qml | 1 +
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)

+++ b/src/controls/Heading.qml
@@ -11,6 +11,7 @@ import org.kde.kirigami.templates as KT
 KT.Heading {
     id: heading
 
+    font.family: Platform.Theme.defaultFont.family
     font.pointSize: {
       let factor = 1;
       switch (heading.level) {
